item.title: IMF upgrades 2026 growth forecast but warns of ‘split’ outlook
item.description: The IMF has raised its 2026 global growth forecast slightly to 3.1%, citing the resilience of advanced economies despite rising energy prices caused by the Iran war. item.title: ‘Breaking Bad’ actor and disability advocate RJ Mitte dies at 34
item.description: Breaking Bad actor and disability rights advocate R.J. Mitte died on Monday at age 34, authorities and his representatives said. Cameron County Justice of the Peace Cyndi Hinojosa told Associated Press she declared Mitte dead at about 1.30pm at what she believed was his home in Brownsville, Texas. She said she was unable to provide a cause but an autopsy will be performed. The actor lived with cerebral palsy. “It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor,...
